anchors.description: Long edge of the white sheet lying flat on the bedspread: near (lower) long edge between the sheet's visible lower-left corner and lower-right corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: Bright white rectangular sheet on the pink patterned bedspread; its long side runs roughly left-right with the two end corners clearly visible against the dark bedspread shadow; the short side is about half the long side in the image, consistent with a standard paper sheet seen obliquely.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Only the category (a sheet of writing/printer paper) is certain, not the stationery format: US Letter long edge 0.2794 m vs A4 0.297 m; the neighborhood suggests US Letter is more likely, and a smaller card format cannot be fully excluded from one oblique view.
